task.title: Preparing the radio for first use

prereq.p: Unpack the radio from the protective film.

choices.choice: Batteries: insert four AA batteries. For details, see .
Mains: connect the power cable to the socket on the back of the radio, then to a 230 V wall outlet.

step.info: If batteries are inserted and the radio is connected to the mains, the radio uses mains power.

step.cmd: Set the power switch in the top-left corner to ON.
Turn the volume knob on the front of the radio to set the volume.

result.p: The radio is ready to use.
